title: Over The Air Update Exploration
description:
Over‑the‑Air (OTA) Update is a mechanism that allows MyHero application updates to be deployed directly from the server to users’ iPad applications, without requiring distribution through the App Store or Company Portal.

Through OTA, the development team can:

- Deploy updates to JavaScript, business logic, UI/UX, and configuration within minutes
- Perform silent updates without user interaction
- Maintain a consistent application version across all active users
background: The update process for the MyHero application still relies heavily on traditional methods through the Company Portal, which require manual processes, longer waiting times, and user‑initiated actions. This approach often results in inconsistent version adoption across the field, causing delays in distributing bug fixes and new features to all sales users simultaneously.
objective:
- Accelerate application update distribution without dependency on the Company Portal
- Ensure 100% version consistency across all users
- Eliminate reliance on manual user actions for application updates
- Enable rapid bug fixes and business logic updates to minimize disruption to sales activities
- Improve operational efficiency while reducing manual distribution overhead on the IT side
impact:
- Deploy in minutes
- Auto update all devices on next app launch
- 66.7% Reduction in app update install time

title: AMO Delta Sync
description: Enhancement of the AMO sync mechanism to trigger automatically after each canvassing or CITA delivery completion, combined with delta sync for master data. Each master data set (downline master and products) has its own SQLite file and its own version signal, checked through a single lightweight request per sync, so an unchanged data set is never re-downloaded. Product changes on the AYO Mitra side raise a version increment, including on removal with a configurable debounce (default 5 minutes) to group bursts of edits into one rebuild.
background: AMO relies solely on time-scheduled sync, so orders completed in the morning and mid-day product changes from the Wholesaler do not reach their destination on the same day. Every sync also re-downloads full product and downline master data even when nothing has changed, making sync slow and wasting mobile data.
objective:
1. Push canvassing and CITA delivery transactions to the server as soon as the device is online, without PG action.
2. Deliver WS product changes to the field within the same working day.
3. Download master data only when it has actually changed on the server.
impact:
1. PG: faster syncs and an always-accurate product and downline list; no new screen, action, or error banner.
2. Mitra / WS: existing product management actions automatically become the signal that pushes changes to the field

description:
QRIS will be introduced as an additional payment method within the MyHero Taking Order process. Once selected by the salesman, the system will generate and display a QRIS code based on the transaction amount for the customer to complete the payment. QRIS will serve as an additional payment option and will not replace hard cash.
background: The current payment and collection process is still largely dependent on hard cash, requiring manual activities from cash collection and deposit through settlement. objective:

- Reduce dependency on cash and eliminate the need for customers to prepare an exact payment amount.
- Streamline the collection, settlement, and disbursement processes across entities.

title: Communicate AYO Order Status to iLogics
description: Provide API for ilogic for detail order status
background:
Saat ini, order yang sudah checkout di AYO akan masuk ke iLogic dengan status Available._x000B_Namun, warehouse tidak memiliki visibilitas penyebab kenapa order belum berubah menjadi Received, karena:
Status booking di iLogic hanya berubah menjadi Received jika status AYO = Diproses
Banyak kondisi valid di AYO yang menyebabkan order belum diproses, misalnya: 
masih menunggu Payment
Review order belum selesai
Belum adamya Konfirmasi perubahan dari partner
Kondisi ini tidak tercapture di iLogic
Akibatnya:
Warehouse tidak bisa membedakan apakah: 
Order memang belum memenuhi business process
Atau ada issue teknis (contoh: iSMS belum mengirim invoice PDF)
objective:
Menambahkan detail status order AYO melalui API ke iLogic, sehingga warehouse dapat:
Mendeteksi hambatan order lebih dini
Mengurangi waktu investigasi manual
Menghindari salah asumsi error sistem
